body.p: Favorable reconsideration of this application, as presently amended and in light of the following discussion, is respectfully requested.
Claims 1-20 are currently pending. Claims 1-3, 5-8, 12, 13, 15-18, and 20 have been
amended by the present Amendment. The changes to the claims are supported by the originally filed specification and claims.1 Thus, no new matter has been added.

In the outstanding Office Action, Claims 1-5, 8, 9, 11-13, and 15-20 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. @ 102(a)(1) as being anticipated by U.S. Publication No. 2016/0129345 (hereinafter "Seok"); Claim 6 was rejected under 35 U.S.C. @ 103 as being unpatentable over Seok in view of U.S. Publication No. 2018/0121086 (hereinafter "Wang"); Claim 7 was rejected under 35 U.S.C. @ 103 as being unpatentable over Seok in view of Wang and U.S. Publication No. 2019/0303201 (hereinafter "Jiang"); and Claims 10 and 14 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. @ 103 as being unpatentable over Seok in view of U.S. Publication No. 2018/0304158 (hereinafter "Miyamae").

Applicant and Applicant's representative thank Examiner Henry for the courtesy of the interview with Applicant's representative on April 11, 2024, at which time possible proposed amendments to Claim 1 were discussed. Amendments based on the discussion during the interview are presented herewith.
Independent Claim 1 is directed to a virtual object control method, the method comprising:
obtaining a skill type of a skill in response to a first touch user operation on a skill control;
displaying, in response to determining that the obtained skill type of the skill is a target skill, a castable region of the skill
in a virtual scene according to a position where a controlled virtual
object is located and a casting range of the skill, the target skill
being a skill that supports selecting a casting position based on a
second touch user operation;
SVG {EMBED HERE} 0.1370.563 Figure 8 and the discussion related thereto in the specification
displaying a casting countdown of the skill in the virtual scene in response to the skill being the target skill; and
controlling, in response to the second touch user operation in the castable region, the controlled virtual object to cast the skill at the casting position on which the second touch user operation is
performed.
Regarding the rejection of Claim 1 under 35 U.S.C. § 102(a)(1), it is respectfully

submitted that Seok fails to disclose "displaying a casting countdown of the skill in the virtual scene in response to the skill being the target skill," as discussed during the interview. Accordingly, it is respectfully submitted that Claim 1 (and all associated dependent claims) patentably defines over Seok.

Independent Claims 15 and 20, although differing in scope and statutory class, patentably define over Seok at least for reasons analogous to the reasons stated above for the patentability of Claim 1. Accordingly, it is respectfully submitted that Claims 15 and 20 (and all associated dependent claims) patentably define over Seok.
Regarding the rejections of dependent Claims 6, 7, 10, and 14 under 35 U.S.C. § 103, it is

respectfully submitted that Claims 6, 7, 10, and 14 patentably define over Seok at least for the reasons stated above for the patentability of Claims 1 and 15, from which Claims 6, 7, 10, and 14depend. Further, Wang, Jiang, and Miyamae were not cited for such deficiencies. Accordingly,it is respectfully submitted that Claims 6, 7, 10, and 14 patentably define over Seok, Wang,Jiang, and Miyamae.

If for any reason the Examiner feels the application is not now in condition for allowance it is respectfully requested that they contact the undersigned practitioner to arrange for an interview to expedite the disposition of this case.
Other than any fees submitted herewith, Applicant believes no further fees are due.
However, if a fee is due, please charge our Deposit Account Number 01-2300, under number 043381.00369 from which the undersigned is authorized to draw.

If this communication is filed after the shortened statutory time period had elapsed and no separate Petition is enclosed, Applicant hereby petitions, under 37 C.F.R. § 1.136(a), to extend the time for filing a response to the outstanding Office Action by the number of months necessary to
avoid abandonment under 37 C.F.R. § 1.135. Please charge any such fee under 37 C.F.R. § 1.17 to Deposit Account No. 01-2300.
